task.title: Relics: accept a full `<relic>#<part>` address in every part option
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M39). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Only `--part` accepts a full `<relic>#<part>` address. `--move-part`, `--remove-part`, `--restore-part`, `--before` and `--after` take a part ID or prefix, so an address pasted from `relic show` exits 4 (not found).

## Wanted

Accept the full address in each of those options, and refuse one that names another relic.

## Done when

- Each option accepts `<relic>#<part>` for the relic being updated.
- An address naming a different relic is refused with a clear message.
